factors.name: enterpriseDistribution
factors.basis: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner on September 8, 2026; planned integration brings Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside Palantir's enterprise perimeter for eligible customers.

risks: Partnership economics and realized customer conversion were not disclosed in the announcement.
unknowns: Revenue contribution, integration timing, customer adoption and capacity required remain unknown.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: commercialExecution
factors.basis: The Palantir agreement provides a new enterprise distribution path and explicitly targets bringing new AI capacity online faster.

risks: Strategic designation is not itself evidence of booked revenue or utilization.
unknowns: No contract value or minimum purchase commitment was stated.

sources.origin: Nebius Newsroom / Palantir and Nebius partnership announcement
facts: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner.
Following integration, Nebius compute and inference endpoints are intended to be available inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter for eligible customers.
The companies said they will work to bring new AI capacity online faster.

result: New September primary-source enterprise distribution evidence added for Alpha reuse; numeric underwriting remains Alpha-owned.
